confirmed.subject: Your {plan} membership is now active
confirmed.title: Welcome to {plan}
confirmed.p1: Your monthly online healthcare membership is active. You can book online/video consultations and use your member benefits right away.
confirmed.p2: You have {credits} online consultation credit(s) available this month.
confirmed.p2Locked: Your consultation credits unlock from your 2nd monthly payment — we'll let you know when they're ready. Any wellness rewards start right away.

renewed.subject: Your {plan} renewed — this month's credits are ready
renewed.title: Your monthly credits are in
renewed.p1: Thanks for staying with us. Your {plan} membership renewed successfully.
renewed.p2: We've added {credits} online consultation credit(s) for the new month. Unused credits don't roll over, so make the most of them.
renewed.p2Locked: Your consultation credits will unlock as your membership matures. Any wellness rewards keep accruing.

perkUnlocked.subject: A new member perk just unlocked
perkUnlocked.title: Perk unlocked
perkUnlocked.p1: Good news — {perk} is now available on your plan after {months} paid month(s).
perkUnlocked.p1Now: Good news — {perk} is now available on your plan.
perkUnlocked.p2: Sign in to your account to start using it.

wellnessEarned.subject: You earned a wellness credit
wellnessEarned.title: Wellness credit earned
wellnessEarned.p1: You earned {credits} wellness credit(s) this month. You now have {balance} in total.
wellnessEarned.p2: Collect enough wellness credits to redeem an eligible home health test kit — postage only.

redemptionConfirmed.subject: Your kit redemption is confirmed
redemptionConfirmed.title: Redemption confirmed
redemptionConfirmed.p1: We've confirmed your redemption of {kit}. Your wellness credits have been applied.
redemptionConfirmed.p2: You can track delivery from your account orders.

reminder.subject: Your membership renews soon
reminder.title: Renewal reminder
reminder.p1: A reminder that your {plan} membership renews on {date} at the usual monthly price.
reminder.p2: No action is needed — your payment method will be charged automatically. You can change or cancel anytime.

canceled.subject: Your membership has been cancelled
canceled.title: Membership cancelled
canceled.p1: Your {plan} membership is cancelled and won't renew again.
canceled.p2: Your benefits continue until {date}. You're welcome back anytime.
